decoded_max_abs_error=0.0118 against the float sine (read back with soundfile)
reproducibility=libsndfile picks a random Ogg stream serial number, so a re-encode differs in its bytes but not in its samples
license=the Pelican project's own; generated from the formula above, no third-party recording
procedure=uv run --no-project --with soundfile==0.14.0 --with numpy python make_fixture.py sine440_1s.ogg
make_fixture.py:
    import numpy as np
    import soundfile as sf
    rate = 48000
    t = np.arange(rate) / rate
    x = (0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 440.0 * t)).astype(np.float32)
    sf.write("sine440_1s.ogg", x, rate, format="OGG", subtype="VORBIS", compression_level=0.5)
